capabilities: Set wrap or clamp line counts (1-10) per property and per cards view
Show full property values in a scrollable box of up to 10 lines
Apply view rules to bases embedded in notes, in Reading view and Live Preview
Manage saved rules from the settings and delete them to restore the core look
Apply a vault-wide default rule to cards views without their own rule (Pro)
extras: Freemium: per-view rules are free; the vault default rule (including for base code blocks) requires a paid Pro tier verified via GitHub sign-in. Makes no network requests until GitHub sign-in; sends no vault data and has no telemetry. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. Rules are stored in the plugin's own data file, not in .base files.
intentEvidence: The plugin changes how the core cards view looks. It does not add a new view type
problem: The core Obsidian Bases cards view gives each property a single line, so long quotes, titles or summaries are cut off after a few words.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Bases cards view styling plugin that wraps long property values onto more lines or clamps them, with rules set per base and view.
